examples.suggested: Petakan hamiltonian kepada sebuah circuit kuantum.
examples.translation: Petakan hamiltonian ke atas sebuah circuit kuantum.
examples.why: "ke atas" is a literal calque of English "onto" and carries a physical on-top-of sense in Malay; "memetakan X kepada Y" is the idiomatic mathematical mapping construction.

editor_note: No semantic drift found — negations, quantities ("no máximo quatro valores", "no máximo três valores", 20 PUBs, arrays 5x1/4x6/3x6), the commuting-observables caveat and the broadcasting rules all match the English, and the informal "você" register holds. The dominant defect is a glossary leak: the plain English noun "circuit" is left untranslated and capitalized as "Circuit"/"Circuits" six times (lines 45, 47, 53, 54, 364, 428) while the correct "circuito" is used five times elsewhere — line 47 even mixes both in one sentence ("vincular ao Circuit ... os objetos `Parameter` do circuito ... se o circuito não tiver"). Secondary nits: "observáveis comutativos" instead of the conventional "observáveis comutantes / que comutam"; the gender slip "uma ou mais arrays de coluna única" against "um array"/"os arrays" everywhere else; "produto externo/cartesiano" adds "cartesiano", which the English "outer/product" (and the code comment `# Outer/Product`) does not say; and line 53 drops the "also" of "must also include measurement instructions".

examples.source: If you have two commuting observables in different PUBs but with the same circuit … These circuits must also include measurement instructions …
examples.suggested: … mas com o mesmo circuito … Esses circuitos também devem incluir instruções de medição …
examples.translation: Se você tiver dois observáveis comutativos em PUBs diferentes, mas com o mesmo Circuit … Esses Circuits devem incluir instruções de medição …
examples.why: The generic English noun "circuit" is left untranslated and capitalized as if it were a class name, six times, while "circuito" is used correctly five times in the same file — line 47 mixes the two renderings inside a single sentence. Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native editor would unify on "circuito".

examples.source: If you have two commuting observables in different PUBs …
examples.suggested: Se você tiver dois observáveis comutantes (que comutam) em PUBs diferentes …
examples.translation: Se você tiver dois observáveis comutativos em PUBs diferentes …
examples.why: "Comutativo" renders "commutative" (a property of an operation); the standard Portuguese domain term for observables that commute with each other is "comutantes" / "que comutam". Imperfect but recognizable.

examples.source: *Example 3*: (outer/product) has a 1x6 parameter value set and a 4x1 observables array.
examples.suggested: *Exemplo 3*: (externo/produto)
examples.translation: *Exemplo 3*: (produto externo/cartesiano) tem um conjunto de valores de parâmetros 1x6 e um array de observáveis 4x1.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no dropped caveats, and the technical narrative (scheduling before padding, YGate not being a basis gate, BasisTranslator re-applied after scheduling) tracks the English exactly. The defects are lexical/grammatical: capitalized English glossary leaks are mixed inconsistently with the correct Portuguese in the same file — "Circuit" appears as "ao Circuit", "Circuits agendados", "neste Circuit", "Circuits ansatz", "decompor Circuits" while "circuito/circuitos" is used everywhere else; likewise "Gates" vs "portas", "Backend" vs "backend", and "Transpiler" vs the verb "transpilar". The leak also drags in gender errors, since "porta" is feminine: "os portas usados", "os portas `ecr` ... são aplicados", "um porta de base" (three times), "portas ... são espaçados regularmente". Minor also: "timing" is rendered as "temporização" in most places but flattened to "o tempo do circuito" at the timeline_drawer paragraph, and the cited paper title was over-translated to "Superconducting qubits" (lowercase q) inside an English proper title.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ty" register holds ("nauczysz się", "Zwróć uwagę", "możesz"), so nothing here misleads — but a native editor would change several things. The core term "circuit" is left as an undeclined English "Circuit" in six places ("najgłębszy Circuit Trottera", "nasze Circuit", "wykonań Circuit", "głębokimi Circuit", "kwantowych Circuit", "Circuit Trottera") while the very same file twice uses the correct Polish "obwód" ("obwodów ewolucji czasowej", "transpilujemy nasz obwód") — an unresolved glossary leak plus within-file split; likewise "10 Qubitów" instead of the conventional "kubitów/qubitów" (lowercase, declined). In §1b the translation injects a clause the English does not have at that point — "$A$ to macierz zależna od $k_j$ i rodzaju używanej formuły iloczynowej (PF) -- w szczególności jej _rzędu_" — while dropping the source's "($S$)"; the added clause is factually true (it appears later, in "Konfiguracja LSE") but it is a pre-emptive duplication, not a translation. Finally, "MPF" takes inconsistent grammatical agreement: plural "MPF redukują", neuter singular "MPF zredukowało", and neuter "MPF zbudowane".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the anti-commutation passage, the spectral-theorem section, the "rank $2^{n-1}$ / only two outcomes $+1$ and $-1$" argument and the $\vert\phi^+\rangle$ non-collapse caveat all survive intact, and core terms are solid and consistent (matrizes de Pauli, operação de Pauli de $n$ qubits, peso, observável, medição projetiva, autovalores/autovetores, posto, decomposição espectral, estimativa de fase). The defects are surface-level glossary leaks concentrated in the phase-estimation section: "gate" is left as capitalized English inside Portuguese noun phrases ("Gates controladas-unitárias", "Gates controladas-identidade são simplesmente Gates identidade") where the field uses "portas", and "circuit" is rendered both correctly ("um circuito baseado em estimativa de fase", "o circuito pode ser simplificado") and as bare English "Circuits" ("requerem Circuits menores", "esses Circuits de estimativa de fase", plus every image alt text "Circuit para medir..."), an inconsistency within the same file. Two smaller slips: "medição projetiva uniquamente definida" uses a non-word calqued from English "uniquely" (should be "unicamente definida"), and the display math keeps English `\text{and}` between $\Pi_0$ and $\Pi_1$. Nothing here misleads a learner; a native technical editor would fix all four.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and no learner would be misled: the intro ("Gere distribuições de quase-probabilidade completas com mitigação de erros amostradas a partir de saídas de circuito quântico"), the batch section and the Next-steps list all match the English exactly, and Sampler/Batch/job/QPU/backend/bitstrings are correctly kept in English per convention. The one real defect is within-file inconsistency on "circuit": it is left as the untranslated, capitalized English noun in three places — "contagens de um único Circuit" (§Executar um único experimento), "contagens de múltiplos Circuits" (§multiple experiments) and the heading "Executar Circuits parametrizados" — while the same term is correctly rendered "circuito" elsewhere ("saídas de circuito quântico", "aumentar a reutilização do circuito", "otimizar o desempenho do circuito nas QPUs"). "Circuits" is also not a Portuguese plural, so the heading reads as a glossary leak rather than a deliberate keep-English choice. Secondarily, "Pratique com primitivas trabalhando na lição de função de custo" is a literal calque of "by working through the lesson" that a native technical writer would phrase as "estudando/percorrendo a lição".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the 30-shots-vs-170,000-shots comparison, the error-suppression-vs-error-mitigation contrast ("サンプリングの形でオーバーヘッドを必要とするエラー軽減とは対照的に"), the $A$ metric definition and its shift/scale-invariance are all rendered correctly, and オブザーバブル / 期待値 / 変分量子固有値ソルバー / 量子フーリエ変換 are the right conventional terms. The defects are consistency and polish, not accuracy. "Circuit" is left as bare capitalized English in the first half (「Circuitを実行すると」, 「Circuit を定義する」, 「Circuit あたり 10,000 ショット」) but becomes 回路 from the Sampler section onward (「回路を作成する」「回路を実行する」); the same split hits backend (「Backend」 in the Admonition and §Sampler vs 「バックエンド」 at the Estimator run step) and qubit (「Qubit」 capitalized in the Overview vs lowercase 「qubit」 everywhere else). 「ハードの制限ではなく」 for "not a hard limitation" is a bad calque — ハード reads as "hardware" in Japanese, so the sentence lands as "not a hardware limit". Also one banned-keigo slip (「ご覧ください」, line 18) and two prose blocks left untranslated (the Package-versions blurb, lines 33–34, and both Changelog entries, lines 348–349).

Backend/バックエンド and Qubit/qubit split the same way. Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: The "Number of qubits" indicated is not a hard limitation but represents rough thresholds where you can expect extremely consistent solution accuracy.

The following sentence rescues the intent, so this stays MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every quantity, shape tuple and condition matches the English ((10, 1024, 3), (28, 10, 1024, 3), (28, 10, 1, 3), "hanya satu nilai tembakan", "Sebaliknya, item samplex membolehkan..."), register is consistently "anda", and "rawakan"/"tatasusunan"/"kamus" are correct and consistent. What a native technical editor would change: (1) "circuit" is left as capitalized English "Circuit" inside Malay prose in seven places ("menyimpan Circuit dan nilai parameternya", "Circuit templat", "tambahkan Circuit sasaran", "Item Circuit dilaksanakan", "nama daftar klasikal dalam Circuit input") instead of the conventional "litar", and "backend" likewise appears capitalized mid-sentence as "(ISA) Backend" — reads as an untranslated glossary leak, not a deliberate keep-English convention, since the surrounding technical vocabulary IS translated. (2) "measurement" is rendered "ukuran" (= size/dimension) rather than "pengukuran": "mengumpulkan gate dan ukuran Circuit ke dalam kotak" and "membatalkan twirling ukuran" — recognizable from context (meas, measure_all) but the wrong noun form. (3) The ISA gloss is word-scrambled: "set seni bina arahan (ISA)" instead of "seni bina set arahan (ISA)". (4) "transpiled" becomes the ad-hoc coinage "ditransail". (5) "bit-flip corrections" becomes the reversed calque "pembetulan balik-bit". None of these would make a learner form a false belief, so this stays MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every load-bearing conditional (controlled-U applies U "jeśli qubit 0 jest w stanie |1⟩, lecz nie robi nic ... gdy qubit 0 jest w stanie |0⟩", the 100%-certainty θ=0 / θ=1/2 statements, "Dzieje się to wtedy, gdy y jest parzyste", the inverse-QFT approximation caveat) and found no inversion, swapped quantity, or dropped caveat; "phase kickback" is handled well and consistently as "mechanizm przeniesienia fazy (ang. phase kickback)". The damage is glossary-substitution artifacts, not translation: three core terms are each split within the file. "gate" is "bramka" in most of the text (bramka Hadamarda, bramki fazowe, bramki SWAP) but leaks as raw English inflected Polish-style in the algorithm section — "jakie Gate'y faktycznie implementujemy", "Istnieje mianowicie Gate, który przekształca", "kombinację Gate'ów", "zbędne Gate'y" — and once as the non-word "niektórych z tych bramka'ów QFT" (line 525). "circuit" is "obwód/obwodu/biblioteki obwodów" early on but becomes raw "Circuit" from line 516 on ("Procedura budowania Circuit QFT", "wymiar Circuit QFT", "wydłużałyby działanie Circuit", "Circuit śledzi", "biblioteki Circuit Qiskit"). "qubit" appears in three shapes: proper Polish "kubitów / dwukubitowego / m-kubitowego", mid-sentence-capitalized and inflected "Qubitów / Qubity / Qubicie / cztero-Qubitowy" (26 occurrences), and — worst — completely uninflected "na stanach qubit", "stan pojedynczego qubit", "Stany qubit", "stan qubit 0 do m-1", which is ungrammatical Polish no native writer would produce. Smaller items: Watrous is spelled "Watrousa" once and "Watrusa" three times; "subroutine" is "podprogram" five times but "podrutynie" once; line 103 has a gender-agreement slip "To obrót" (should be "Ten obrót") and line 95 the calqued "obraca się wokół zespolonej płaszczyzny" (natural Polish: "nawija się na płaszczyźnie zespolonej"). Informal "ty" register holds cleanly (Możesz myśleć, Zauważ, zapoznaj się, twoim układzie) with no Pan/Pani; gendered address is inconsistent though — "Być może byłeś w stanie" (line 57, masculine only) vs "zauważyłeś(-aś)" and "zaznajomiony(-a)" elsewhere. None of this misleads a learner, but a native technical editor would normalize all of it.

examples.suggested: Procedura budowania obwodu QFT$_{2^m}$ na $m$ kubitach jest iteracyjna … obwód śledzi, gdzie powinien znajdować się każdy stan kubitu
examples.translation: Procedura budowania Circuit QFT$_{2^m}$ na $m$ Qubitach jest iteracyjna … Circuit śledzi, gdzie *powinien* znajdować się każdy stan Qubitu
examples.why: 'circuit' is rendered 'obwód' in the first two thirds of the file (schemat obwodu, biblioteki obwodów Qiskit) and then switches to bare English 'Circuit' — including the odd 'biblioteki Circuit Qiskit' — splitting one concept across two labels in the same document.

examples.source: Basis transformations are regularly done on qubit states, too. For example, the state of a single qubit … each binary digit represents the state of qubit 0 through m-1
examples.suggested: …na stanach kubitów. Na przykład stan pojedynczego kubitu … reprezentuje stan kubitu 0 do $m-1$
examples.translation: Transformacje bazy są regularnie wykonywane również na stanach qubit. Na przykład stan pojedynczego qubit … każda cyfra binarna reprezentuje stan qubit 0 do $m-1$
examples.why: Uninflected 'qubit' in oblique cases is ungrammatical Polish; the same file elsewhere uses correct declined forms ('układu dwukubitowego', 'stanami kubitów', 'stanu $m$-kubitowego') and 26 mid-sentence-capitalized 'Qubitów/Qubity/Qubicie' — three shapes of one term.

examples.source: how the phase of this amplitude winds around the complex plane … And we can see this winding in the plot
examples.suggested: jak faza tej amplitudy nawija się na płaszczyźnie zespolonej … Ten obrót widać na wykresie
examples.translation: jak faza tej amplitudy obraca się wokół zespolonej płaszczyzny … To obrót możemy zobaczyć na wykresie
examples.why: 'obraca się wokół zespolonej płaszczyzny' is a calque that literally says the phase rotates *around* the plane rather than winding *in* it, and the adjective order 'zespolonej płaszczyzny' is English word order (Polish: 'płaszczyzny zespolonej'); 'To obrót' is a gender-agreement slip for 'Ten obrót'.

examples.source: the SWAPs don't appear after each subroutine … see John Watrous' lesson
examples.suggested: …po każdym podprogramie … lekcją Johna Watrousa
examples.translation: operacje SWAP nie pojawiają się po każdej podrutynie … lekcją Johna Watrusa
examples.why: 'subroutine' is 'podprogram' five times elsewhere in the file but 'podrutyna' once; the author's name is 'Watrousa' at line 479 and misspelled 'Watrusa' three times (570, 589, 625). Both are within-file inconsistencies a native editor would normalize.

editor_note: Prose is generally fluent and faithful (Background, SPSA section and the barren-plateau paragraph read naturally, informal "ty" holds throughout: "Zauważ", "spróbuj", "Twój czas wykonania"), but terminology is the weak spot. "circuit" is rendered three ways in one file: left as an undeclined, capitalized English "Circuit" mid-sentence ("Abstrakcyjny Circuit", "procedurę optymalizacji naszego Circuit", "optymalizację parametrów Circuit" — a glossary leak), as "układ" ("biblioteki układów Qiskit", "głębokość przetranspilowanego układu"), while "układ" is simultaneously used for "system" ("rozmiarem układu"). "observable" is rendered with the adjective "obserwowalny" instead of the standard Polish noun "obserwabla", leaving "Docelowy Circuit i obserwowalny" dangling without a head noun. Most serious: "single-qubit rotations" became "jednobitowych rotacji" (single-BIT), the one place in the file where the qubit/bit distinction collapses; and transpiler "pass"/"pass manager" became "przejścia"/"menedżerów przejść" (transition), which collides with "kwantowych przejściach fazowych" used earlier — "przebieg" is the conventional term.

examples.source: we use the `efficient_su2` ansatz from Qiskit's circuit library, which constructs layers of single-qubit rotations and entangling gates
examples.suggested: …który konstruuje warstwy rotacji jednokubitowych i bramek splątujących
examples.translation: używamy ansatza `efficient_su2` z biblioteki układów Qiskit, który konstruuje warstwy jednobitowych rotacji i bramek splątujących
examples.why: "jednobitowy" means single-BIT (classical); the rest of the file correctly says "kubit"/"kubitów". In the one sentence that defines the ansatz structure it erases the bit/qubit distinction and suggests the rotations act on classical bits.

examples.source: Input: Abstract circuit, observable … generate an optimization routine for our circuit … we optimized the circuit for the backend in Step 2 … optimizing the circuit parameters
examples.suggested: Wejście: abstrakcyjny obwód, obserwabla … procedurę optymalizacji naszego obwodu … zoptymalizowaliśmy obwód dla backendu w Kroku 2 … optymalizację parametrów obwodu
examples.translation: Wejście: Abstrakcyjny Circuit, obserwowalny … wygenerować procedurę optymalizacji naszego Circuit … zoptymalizowaliśmy Circuit dla backendu w Kroku 2 … optymalizację parametrów Circuit
examples.why: English "Circuit" is left capitalized and undeclined mid-sentence ("naszego Circuit", "parametrów Circuit") — reads as an untranslated glossary token, not Polish. The same concept is rendered "układ" elsewhere in the file ("biblioteki układów Qiskit", "głębokość przetranspilowanego układu"), so the term is split within one document.

examples.source: Output: Target circuit and observable, optimized for the selected QPU
examples.suggested: Wyjście: docelowy obwód i obserwabla, zoptymalizowane dla wybranego QPU
examples.translation: Wyjście: Docelowy Circuit i obserwowalny, zoptymalizowane dla wybranego QPU
examples.why: In Polish physics the noun for "observable" is "obserwabla"; "obserwowalny" is an adjective ("observable/visible") and here is left with no noun to modify, so the bullet reads as a fragment rather than naming the object passed to the Estimator.

examples.source: which provides the highest level of optimization of the preset pass managers. We also include `ALAPScheduleAnalysis` and `PadDynamicalDecoupling` scheduling passes
examples.suggested: …spośród wstępnie zdefiniowanych menedżerów przebiegów (pass managerów). Dodajemy również przebiegi harmonogramowania…
examples.translation: co zapewnia najwyższy poziom optymalizacji spośród wstępnie zdefiniowanych menedżerów przejść. Dodajemy również przejścia harmonogramowania `ALAPScheduleAnalysis` i `PadDynamicalDecoupling`
examples.why: A transpiler "pass" is a compiler pass — conventionally "przebieg" (or kept in English). "Przejście" means transition/passage and clashes with "kwantowych przejściach fazowych" used earlier in the same file, making the compilation step read as something physical.

editor_note: The translation drops the entire closing paragraph of the lesson: the English ends with "Circuit depth is a double-edged sword… we can't increase the depth too much because the hardware noise will cause the fidelity to diminish… take some time between now and the next lesson to think about a problem… your solution may not pan out, and that's fine. That's why this is research." The Romanian file simply stops after "…trebuie să iei în considerare scalarea." — so the lesson's central closing caveat (the depth/noise trade-off, the "moving target" sweet spot) and the assigned reflection exercise are missing, and the Romanian learner ends the course module with an incomplete and blunter takeaway. Secondary, non-misleading problems: the calque "acesta este doar un testament al cât de buni am devenit" (Romanian "testament" = last will; should be "o dovadă a"), the non-word "ubiquitară" for "ubiquitous" (standard: "omniprezentă"), the ungrammatical "pentru una dintre primele dată" (for "for one of the first times"), gender/agreement slips ("se comportă ca un sticlă", "Multe algoritmi variaționali"), the typo "să eVoluezi", inconsistent plural for hadron ("hadroni" vs "hadroane" in the same file), a stray capitalized "un Qubit", and one untranslated image alt text ("Results from Ising spin-glass paper") while all the others are translated.

examples.source: Circuit depth is a double-edged sword. We need it to be considerably large to do interesting work that classical computers can't, but right now, we can't increase the depth too much because the hardware noise will cause the fidelity to diminish. It's all about finding that sweet spot and knowing that it's a moving target. So, take some time between now and the next lesson to think about a problem you have come across in your research, and how you might approach it with what we have learned so far. And hey, your solution may not pan out, and that's fine. That's why this is research.
examples.suggested: Adâncimea circuitului este o sabie cu două tăișuri. Avem nevoie ca ea să fie considerabil de mare pentru a face lucruri interesante, pe care calculatoarele clasice nu le pot face, dar în prezent nu putem crește prea mult adâncimea, deoarece zgomotul hardware va face ca fidelitatea să scadă. Totul ține de găsirea acelui punct optim, știind totodată că este o țintă mobilă. Așa că ia-ți puțin timp de acum până la lecția următoare pentru a te gândi la o problemă întâlnită în cercetarea ta și la modul în care ai putea să o abordezi cu ceea ce am învățat până acum. Și, hei, s-ar putea ca soluția ta să nu funcționeze, și e în regulă. De aceea se numește cercetare.
examples.translation: (entirely absent — the Romanian file ends at "…trebuie să iei în considerare scalarea.")
examples.why: A full closing paragraph is missing, including the lesson's key caveat that circuit depth cannot simply be increased because hardware noise degrades fidelity, and the between-lessons reflection exercise. The Romanian learner never receives this teaching point.

examples.source: And really this is just a testament to how good we've gotten at classical computing.
examples.suggested: Și, de fapt, acest lucru este doar o dovadă a cât de buni am devenit la calculul clasic.
examples.translation: Și, de fapt, acesta este doar un testament al cât de buni am devenit la calculul clasic.
examples.why: "Testament" in Romanian means a last will/testament; "un testament al…" is a raw calque of English "a testament to" that a native technical writer would never use.

examples.source: This area is ubiquitous in computing, so the use-cases are numerous and varied.
examples.suggested: Acest domeniu este omniprezent în informatică, așa că există cazuri de utilizare numeroase și variate.
examples.translation: Această zonă este ubiquitară în calcul, deci cazurile de utilizare sunt numeroase și variate.
examples.why: "ubiquitară" is not a Romanian word (Anglicism spelled from English); the standard rendering is "omniprezentă".

examples.source: good results are being reported on over 100 qubits for one of the first times.
examples.suggested: …iar rezultate bune sunt raportate pe mai mult de 100 de qubiți, pentru una dintre primele dăți.
examples.translation: iar rezultate bune sunt raportate pentru mai mult de 100 de qubiți pentru una dintre primele dată.
examples.why: "pentru una dintre primele dată" is ungrammatical (number/gender mismatch); it reads as untouched machine output.

examples.source: hadron / hadrons
examples.suggested: Use "hadroni" consistently throughout (exemple de hadroni, lăsăm hadronii să evolueze, astfel de hadroni).
examples.translation: "hadroni" (simularea hadronilor, pachetul de undă al hadronilor) vs "hadroane" (Câteva exemple de hadroane, hadroanele să evolueze, astfel de hadroane)
examples.why: The plural of "hadron" is rendered two different ways within the same file (masculine "hadroni" and neuter "hadroane"); the conventional Romanian physics plural is "hadroni".

examples.source: we need to look for experiments that make use of most of the qubits currently available on a given QPU
examples.suggested: …trebuie să căutăm experimente care să folosească majoritatea qubiților disponibili în prezent pe un QPU dat
examples.translation: trebuie să căutăm experimente care să facă uz de cât mai mulți qubiți disponibili în prezent pe un QPU dat
examples.why: "most of the qubits" (a majority) is softened to "as many qubits as possible", a mild quantitative shift in the guidance given to the learner.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — the meaning tracks the English faithfully throughout (no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; "peste 1.000 de teste", "converge nominal în O(1) pași", "fără zgomot de eșantionare" are all correct), and the informal "tu" register holds cleanly ("poți executa", "consultă", "dacă ești gata să îl instalezi"). But a native technical editor would still change several things. First, "circuit" is rendered two ways inside the same bullet: the heading says "Biblioteca de circuit-uri" while the body of that very bullet says "O gamă vastă de circuite" — plus a stray capitalized "bazate pe Circuit" and "construirea Circuit-urilor"; plain Romanian "circuite" is the standard and should be used uniformly. Second, "gate" is rendered as the hybrid loan "Gate-uri / Gate-urilor", capitalized mid-sentence, where Romanian quantum documentation says "porți (cuantice)" — recognizable, but not the conventional domain term and typographically odd. Third, "committed to" is calqued twice as "IBM este angajat față de dezvoltarea responsabilă" and "IBM Quantum este angajat să livreze", which reads as translationese; and "o metodă iterativă precondiționate" has an agreement error (should be "precondiționată").

examples.source: **Circuit library** ... - A vast range of circuits, instructions, and gates
examples.suggested: **Biblioteca de circuite** ... - O gamă vastă de circuite, instrucțiuni și porți
examples.translation: **Biblioteca de circuit-uri** ... - O gamă vastă de circuite, instrucțiuni și Gate-uri
examples.why: 'circuit' is split within a single bullet between the loan 'circuit-uri' and the correct Romanian 'circuite'; the same split recurs at 'construirea Circuit-urilor' (line 25), 'bazate pe Circuit' (line 27) and 'biblioteca de circuit-uri' (line 66), while lines 21/31/57 use 'circuite'. Not confusing, but a native editor would unify on 'circuite'.

examples.source: For initializing and manipulating registers, circuits, instructions, gates, parameters, and control flow objects.
examples.suggested: ...registrelor, circuitelor, instrucțiunilor, porților, parametrilor și obiectelor de control al fluxului.
examples.translation: Pentru inițializarea și manipularea registrelor, circuitelor, instrucțiunilor, Gate-urilor, parametrilor și obiectelor de control al fluxului.
examples.why: 'gate' is the one core term here rendered as an English hybrid loan ('Gate-uri'), capitalized mid-sentence in a list of otherwise lowercase Romanian nouns. Romanian quantum writing uses 'porți (cuantice)'; the loan is recognizable so this does not mislead, but it is not the conventional term and the capitalization is a typographic slip.

examples.source: IBM is committed to the responsible development of quantum computing.
examples.suggested: IBM se angajează să dezvolte responsabil calculul cuantic.
examples.translation: IBM este angajat față de dezvoltarea responsabilă a calculului cuantic.
examples.why: 'is committed to' is calqued as 'este angajat față de', which no Romanian technical writer would produce; 'a fi angajat' reads as 'employed'. The same calque returns at line 45 ('IBM Quantum este angajat să livreze cel mai performant SDK posibil').

examples.source: ...followed by either direct LU factorization or a preconditioned iterative method that nominally converges in O(1) steps
examples.suggested: ...fie de o metodă iterativă precondiționată care converge nominal în O(1) pași
examples.translation: ...urmat fie de factorizare LU directă, fie de o metodă iterativă precondiționate care converge nominal în O(1) pași
examples.why: Gender/number agreement error: 'metodă' is feminine singular, so the participle must be 'precondiționată', not 'precondiționate'. Meaning is unaffected, but it is a visible grammar slip in an otherwise clean paragraph.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the primal/dual contrast, the kernel-trick argument, the "measurements are the source of non-linearity" point, and the Pérez-Salinas quote all survive intact, and register is correctly casual with no ครับ/ค่ะ. What a native technical editor would change is a cluster of calques: "setting" is rendered three times as "การตั้งค่า" (= software settings/configuration) at lines 33, 41 and 163 where Thai wants "บริบท/กรณี"; "introduce non-linearity to quantum circuits" becomes "แนะนำ non-linearity ให้กับ quantum circuits" (line 146), where "แนะนำ" means recommend/introduce-a-person, and it contradicts the heading's own correct "การนำ 'ควอนตัม' เข้าสู่ machine learning"; and "generalize the SVM approach" becomes bare "สรุป SVM" (line 63, reads as "summarize"), inconsistent with the correct "การสรุปทั่วไป" used for the Generalizations heading and at line 110. Line 167 also produces the half-translated redundancy "พลังในการแทน representation ของโมเดล", and three hedges are dropped ("in some ways" line 43, "in principle" line 124, "potentially" many layers line 159). None of these would make a learner form a false belief, but each is a real edit.

examples.source: This is precisely the classical machine learning setting. / In this setting, the data points with the smallest distance… / In the classical setting, information would flow from left to right
examples.suggested: ซึ่งนี่คือบริบทของ classical machine learning โดยแท้ / ในกรณีนี้ จุดข้อมูล… / ในกรณีแบบ classical ข้อมูลจะไหล…
examples.translation: ซึ่งนี่คือการตั้งค่า classical machine learning โดยตรง / ในการตั้งค่านี้ จุดข้อมูลที่มีระยะทางน้อยที่สุด… / ในการตั้งค่าแบบ classical ข้อมูลจะไหลจากซ้ายไปขวา
examples.why: ‘setting’ here means context/scenario, but ‘การตั้งค่า’ is the Thai word for software settings/configuration. Repeated three times, it reads as machine translation to a Thai engineer.

examples.source: There are different methods that we can use to introduce non-linearity to quantum circuits.
examples.suggested: มีวิธีต่างๆ ที่เราสามารถใช้เพื่อเพิ่ม non-linearity เข้าไปใน quantum circuits
examples.translation: มีวิธีต่างๆ ที่เราสามารถใช้เพื่อแนะนำ non-linearity ให้กับ quantum circuits
examples.why: ‘แนะนำ’ = recommend / introduce a person, not incorporate. The file already handles the same verb correctly in the heading ‘การนำ "ควอนตัม" เข้าสู่ machine learning’, so this is an inconsistency as well as a false friend.

examples.source: quantum circuits only implement unitary operations, which are simply linear
examples.suggested: quantum circuits จะ implement ได้เฉพาะ unitary operations ซึ่งเป็นการดำเนินการเชิงเส้นเท่านั้น
examples.translation: quantum circuits จะ implement เฉพาะ unitary operations ซึ่งเป็นเชิงเส้นอย่างง่าย
examples.why: ‘อย่างง่าย’ turns ‘simply/merely linear’ into ‘simple linear’, weakening the argument that unitaries are *only ever* linear — the very reason non-linearity has to be added. The surrounding sentences still carry the point, so it stops short of misleading.

examples.source: we can generalize the SVM approach to cases where the original data are not linearly separable
examples.suggested: เราสามารถขยาย SVM ให้ครอบคลุมกรณีที่ข้อมูลต้นฉบับไม่สามารถแยกแบบ linear ได้
examples.translation: เราสามารถสรุป SVM ไปยังกรณีที่ข้อมูลต้นฉบับไม่สามารถแยกแบบ linear ได้
examples.why: Bare ‘สรุป’ reads as ‘summarize’; the same concept is rendered correctly as ‘การสรุปทั่วไป’ in the Generalizations heading and at line 110, so the term splits within the file.

examples.source: data reuploading is a technique that we can use to enhance the expressiveness and representational power of the model
examples.suggested: …เพื่อเพิ่ม expressivity และความสามารถในการแทนค่า (representational power) ของโมเดล
examples.translation: data reuploading เป็นเทคนิคที่เราสามารถใช้เพื่อเพิ่มความสามารถในการแสดงออกและพลังในการแทน representation ของโมเดล
examples.why: ‘พลังในการแทน representation’ leaves the English noun stranded inside a Thai noun phrase — a half-substituted glossary artifact no native writer would produce.

examples.source: in some ways the most straightforward way is that shown in f_1 / we could in principle write the whole neural network as one big matrix multiplication / this function includes potentially many layers of many weights
examples.suggested: add back the hedges: ‘ในแง่หนึ่ง วิธีที่ตรงไปตรงมาที่สุด…’, ‘โดยหลักการแล้วเราก็สามารถเขียน…’, ‘ฟังก์ชันนี้อาจรวมถึงหลายชั้น…’
examples.translation: วิธีที่ตรงไปตรงมาที่สุดคือที่แสดงใน $f_1$ / เราก็สามารถเขียน neural network ทั้งหมดเป็นการคูณเมทริกซ์ขนาดใหญ่ตัวเดียวได้ / ฟังก์ชันนี้รวมถึงหลายชั้นของ weights จำนวนมาก
examples.why: Three hedges are dropped, so each claim reads slightly more absolute than the English. Individually small, but they accumulate in teaching prose.

examples.source: For some choices of Φ, we may even be able to write…
examples.suggested: สำหรับ $\Phi$ บางแบบ เราอาจสามารถเขียน…
examples.translation: สำหรับบางการเลือก $\Phi,$ เราอาจสามารถเขียน…
examples.why: ‘บางการเลือก’ is a word-for-word calque of ‘some choices’; Thai does not nominalize this way, and the natural form puts the qualifier after the symbol.

editor_note: Nothing in this file misleads: the load-bearing technical claims are all faithful — the CX setup keeps left=control / right=target ("Qubit ทางซ้ายเป็น control และ Qubit ทางขวาเป็น target"), the qubit-ordering caveat is intact ("Qiskit นับ Qubit เริ่มจาก 0 จากขวาไปซ้าย"), and core terms are correct and consistent (เวกเตอร์สถานะ, เมธอด, คลาส, การดำเนินการ, สปิน; Qubit / tensor product / Bell state kept in English throughout). What a native technical editor would still change: (1) the discourse calque "ที่นี่" ("Here, '+', '-' …" → line 63) — Thai uses ในที่นี้ for a discourse "here"; ที่นี่ means a physical place, and it reads as raw MT. (2) Section-heading policy is split: "## Tensor products" is left in English while "## การวัดบางส่วน" is translated. (3) Three small English qualifiers are silently dropped — "naturally" (line 74), "alternatively" (line 161), "Again" (line 116) — plus "square root" left untranslated at line 30 where รากที่สอง is the ordinary Thai term, and "สปินเชิงกลควอนตัม" (line 63) is a stiff calque of "quantum mechanical spin" where สปินในกลศาสตร์ควอนตัม is idiomatic. Register convention holds — casual throughout, no ครับ/ค่ะ.

examples.source: Here, "+", "-" or "right" and "left" come from the context of quantum mechanical spin
examples.suggested: ในที่นี้ "+", "-" หรือ "right" และ "left" มาจากบริบทของสปินในกลศาสตร์ควอนตัม
examples.translation: ที่นี่ "+", "-" หรือ "right" และ "left" มาจากบริบทของสปินเชิงกลควอนตัม
examples.why: ที่นี่ is the locative 'at this place'; Thai discourse 'here' (= at this point in the text) is ในที่นี้. Word-for-word calque a Thai technical writer would never produce. สปินเชิงกลควอนตัม is likewise a stiff calque of the English adjective stack.

examples.source: ## Tensor products … ## Partial measurements
examples.suggested: Pick one policy: either translate both (e.g. ## ผลคูณเทนเซอร์) or leave both English
examples.translation: ## Tensor products … ## การวัดบางส่วน
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency in heading treatment: one section header is left wholly in English, the sibling is fully translated. Not misleading (the body consistently keeps 'tensor product' in English), but a reviewer would unify it.

examples.source: An alternative is to use the `^` operation for tensor products, which naturally gives the same results.
examples.suggested: … ซึ่งย่อมให้ผลลัพธ์เหมือนกัน
examples.translation: ทางเลือกหนึ่งคือใช้การดำเนินการ `^` สำหรับ tensor product ซึ่งให้ผลลัพธ์เหมือนกัน
examples.why: 'naturally' is dropped. Pedagogically it signals 'this is expected, not a coincidence'; without it the sentence merely asserts equality. Same class of drop at line 161 ('alternatively' in 'We can, alternatively, provide a list of integers') and line 116 ('Again, like in the vector case').

examples.source: as well as the square root function from `NumPy`
examples.suggested: รวมถึงฟังก์ชันรากที่สอง (`sqrt`) จาก `NumPy`
examples.translation: รวมถึงฟังก์ชัน square root จาก `NumPy`
examples.why: 'square root' is a plain mathematical term with a settled Thai rendering (รากที่สอง); leaving it in English here is unmotivated, since it is not an API identifier in the prose — the identifier is `sqrt` in the code cell.

examples.source: The argument is interpreted as the tensor factor on the right.
examples.suggested: อาร์กิวเมนต์นี้จะถูกตีความเป็น tensor factor ทางขวา
examples.translation: argument ถูกตีความเป็น tensor factor ทางขวา
examples.why: Sentence opens with a bare lowercase English noun and uses the bald passive ถูกตีความ with no classifier/determiner — reads as MT output. Meaning is correct; only the surface is stiff.

editor_note: Nothing misleading: the physics is faithful (stress/strain function assignments to $u$/$\sigma$, the 0–0.95 grid with 30 sample points and step 0.2375, the 0–1 grid with step 0.04, and the benchmark table all match the English), domain terms are kept in English consistently and correctly (qubit, observable, ansatz, loss function, boundary condition, shots→"shot", optimizer, trial solution), and the register is correctly informal ("maaari kang", "mo", no po/opo). What a native technical editor would still change is a handful of English-participle calques: "papel ng paglalarawan ng H-DES ng ColibriTD" for "H-DES description paper" (a native would write "papel na naglalarawan ng H-DES"), "Ang isinasaalang-alang na bar" for "The considered bar" (natural Tagalog is "Ang bar na isinasaalang-alang"), "sa buong isang malaking circuit" for "throughout one big circuit", and the inverted determiner in "Ang mga tanging tinatanggap na initial condition". Also minor: "can solve complex multi-physics problems" is softened to "kayang harapin" (can tackle/face) in both the frontmatter description and the Overview, and in "Magsimula" the hyperlink anchor drifted off "saved your account" onto "sa iyong lokal na environment" (meaning still intact).

examples.source: This function is based on the algorithm described in ColibriTD's H-DES description paper.
examples.suggested: …sa [papel na naglalarawan ng H-DES ng ColibriTD]
examples.translation: Ang function na ito ay nakabatay sa algorithm na inilalarawan sa [papel ng paglalarawan ng H-DES ng ColibriTD]
examples.why: "papel ng paglalarawan" is a word-for-word calque of the English noun stack; Tagalog prefers a relative clause ("papel na naglalarawan ng…"). Meaning survives, but no native technical writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: The considered bar is of unitary length.
examples.suggested: Ang bar na isinasaalang-alang ay may haba na isang yunit.
examples.translation: Ang isinasaalang-alang na bar ay may unitary na haba.
examples.why: Fronted participle "Ang isinasaalang-alang na bar" mirrors English "The considered bar"; Tagalog puts the modifier after the head noun. "unitary na haba" also leaves an English word that collides with the quantum sense of "unitary" — "haba na isang yunit" is clearer.

examples.source: By stacking 10 identical circuits and evaluating the 10 identical observables on different qubits throughout one big circuit…
examples.suggested: …sa iba't ibang qubit sa loob ng iisang malaking circuit…
examples.translation: Sa pag-stack ng 10 magkaparehong circuit at pag-evaluate ng 10 magkaparehong observable sa iba't ibang qubit sa buong isang malaking circuit…
examples.why: "sa buong isang malaking circuit" is an ungrammatical-sounding literal rendering of "throughout one big circuit"; "sa loob ng iisang malaking circuit" carries the same idea naturally.

examples.source: Currently, the only accepted initial conditions are linear functions: $ax + b$.
examples.suggested: Sa kasalukuyan, ang tanging tinatanggap na initial conditions ay mga linear function: $ax + b$.
examples.translation: Sa kasalukuyan, ang mga tanging tinatanggap na initial condition ay mga linear function: $ax + b$.
examples.why: "ang mga tanging" stacks the plural marker before "tanging" (only), which reads stiff; "ang tanging" is the idiomatic form. Meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, dropped caveats, or swapped quantities; the compatibility tabs, the "value set after initialization wins" rule, and the copy-semantics paragraph ("hindi nakakaapekto sa mga opsyon na pagmamay-ari ng primitive") all match the English, and domain terms follow the sensible keep-in-English convention (qubit, shot, gate, circuit, backend, measurement, ground state, twirling) applied consistently, with "Mga pagpipilian" used uniformly for "Choices". What a native technical editor would still change is phrasing, not content: line 48 calques "both during and after" as "parehong sa panahon ng at pagkatapos ng pag-initialize ng primitive", an English-shaped coordination Tagalog does not build that way, and the sentence then repeats "pag-initialize ng primitive" verbatim; line 153 renders the boolean-option gloss "Whether to reset..." as "Kung ire-reset ang mga qubit...", which without the interrogative particle reads as a conditional "if" rather than "whether"; and line 42 "ay may uri na `dataclass` ng Python" is a stiff word-order rendering of "is the `dataclass` Python type". Informal register holds — no po/opo anywhere.

examples.source: If an option is specified both during and after primitive initialization, the value set after initializing the primitive is used.
examples.suggested: Kung tinukoy ang isang opsyon bago at pagkatapos ng pag-initialize ng primitive, ang halagang itinakda pagkatapos ang gagamitin.
examples.translation: Kung ang isang opsyon ay tinukoy parehong sa panahon ng at pagkatapos ng pag-initialize ng primitive, ginagamit ang halagang itinakda pagkatapos ng pag-initialize ng primitive.
examples.why: "parehong sa panahon ng at pagkatapos ng" is a direct calque of "both during and after" — Tagalog does not coordinate two prepositional phrases across a shared object this way, and the full phrase "pag-initialize ng primitive" is then repeated verbatim in the same sentence. Grammatical but visibly machine-shaped; meaning is correct.

examples.source: Whether to reset the qubits to the ground state for each shot.
examples.suggested: Kung ire-reset ba ang mga qubit sa ground state para sa bawat shot.
examples.translation: Kung ire-reset ang mga qubit sa ground state para sa bawat shot.
examples.why: Without the interrogative particle "ba", "Kung ire-reset ang..." reads as a conditional ("if the qubits are reset...") rather than the option-gloss sense "whether to reset". A learner still infers the right thing from the True/False choices below, so this is not misleading — but it is the wrong grammatical mood for a boolean-option description.

examples.source: The `options` attribute is the `dataclass` Python type.
examples.suggested: Ang attribute na `options` ay isang Python `dataclass`.
examples.translation: Ang attribute na `options` ay may uri na `dataclass` ng Python.
examples.why: "may uri na `dataclass` ng Python" stacks the linker and the possessive to imitate English "the `dataclass` Python type"; a Tagalog-writing engineer would simply say it is a Python `dataclass`. Defensible in meaning, stiff in delivery.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the Trotterization derivation, the commuting/non-commuting distinction, the 67% spin-swap statement and the transverse/longitudinal (α=0° vs α=±90°) contrast all survive intact, "expectation value" is correctly and consistently "математичне сподівання", and the informal "ти" register holds with no Ви slips. The file nevertheless splits its core vocabulary in half: sections 1–3 translate the domain properly ("квантова схема", "квантові вентилі", "двокубітні вентилі"), but section 4 onward drops untranslated English nouns into inflected Ukrainian sentences — "задай початковий Circuit", "Вкажемо Backend", "транспілюємо Circuit під обраний Backend", "підрахуй кількість Gate та глибину Circuit" — which no Ukrainian technical writer would write and which contradicts the earlier renderings. Suzuki is spelled three ways in one file (Судзукі–Троттер §2.2/§3.1, Сузукі–Троттер §3.2/§3.3, bare Suzuki–Trotter in the fourth-order section), and "qubit" appears once as the hybrid "на $n$ qubit-ах" (§1) against "двокубітні/однокубітні" (§2.4). Smaller native-editor fixes: the typo "могуть" (→ можуть), the gender error "два орієнтації" (→ дві орієнтації), "рекуррентною" (→ рекурентною), and the colloquial "залізо" for hardware in the §4 headings.

examples.source: Then set the initial circuit … We specify a backend … Then we transpile the circuit for the selected backend … Check out the circuit … count the number of gates and depth of the circuit
examples.suggested: Потім задай початкову схему … Вкажемо бекенд … Потім транспілюємо схему під обраний бекенд … Перевіримо схему … підрахуй кількість вентилів і глибину схеми
examples.translation: Потім задай початковий Circuit … Вкажемо Backend … Потім транспілюємо Circuit під обраний Backend … Перевіримо Circuit … підрахуй кількість Gate та глибину Circuit
examples.why: Untranslated English nouns are dropped uninflected into Ukrainian sentences from section 4 onward, while sections 1–3 correctly use «схема» and «вентиль» («Підготовка квантової схеми», «глибина двокубітної схеми», «кількість вентилів»). The same two concepts therefore carry two different names in one lesson; the section-4 form also reads as raw glossary leakage rather than written Ukrainian.

examples.source: second-order Suzuki–Trotter … fourth-order Suzuki–Trotter
examples.suggested: Pick one — e.g. «Сузукі–Троттер» — and use it in all three places
examples.translation: Судзукі–Троттер другого порядку (§2.2, §3.1) / формули Сузукі–Троттера другого порядку (§3.2, §3.3) / четвертим порядком Suzuki–Trotter (§4 appendix)
examples.why: The same product formula is named three different ways within one file (Судзукі / Сузукі / Latin Suzuki). A learner comparing §3.1 with §3.2 and the appendix cannot tell they are being told about the same method by the same name.

examples.source: a tensor product of Pauli terms acting on $n$ qubits … two-qubit gates have higher error rates than single-qubit gates
examples.suggested: …що діє на $n$ кубітах …
examples.translation: тензорний добуток термів Паулі, що діє на $n$ qubit-ах … двокубітні вентилі мають вищий рівень похибок, ніж однокубітні
examples.why: The hybrid «qubit-ах» (English stem plus Ukrainian case ending, joined by a hyphen) is not a Ukrainian word form; the file's own «двокубітні / однокубітні» a few sections later shows the correct stem «кубіт».

examples.source: some code snippets might become deprecated … These spins can have two orientations … can be evaluated using the following recursion relation
examples.suggested: …можуть бути застарілими … Ці спіни можуть мати дві орієнтації … за таким рекурентним співвідношенням
examples.translation: деякі фрагменти коду могуть бути застарілими … Ці спіни можуть мати два орієнтації … обчислюється за такою рекуррентною формулою
examples.why: Three surface errors a native editor would catch on one pass: «могуть» is a non-word (можуть); «два орієнтації» takes the masculine numeral with a feminine noun (дві орієнтації); «рекуррентною» doubles the р under Russian/English influence (Ukrainian: рекурентний).

examples.source: Executing on the quantum hardware … Construct circuit for HW experiment … Optimize for target hardware
examples.suggested: Виконання на квантовому обладнанні … Побудова схеми для апаратного експерименту … Оптимізація під цільове обладнання
examples.translation: Виконання на квантовому залізі … Побудова Circuit для експерименту на залізі … Оптимізація для цільового заліза
examples.why: «Залізо» is shop-floor slang for hardware; in a course heading it clashes with the otherwise neutral-technical register of the rest of the file (which says «квантових пристроїв», «квантових комп'ютерів»).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, the "56 times longer than an `x` gate", "250 мікросекунд", "останні 28 повних днів" and the billing caveat ("це НЕ є часом, що використовується для виставлення рахунків") all survive intact, and the informal "ти" register holds everywhere (Дивись / Зверни увагу / Твоє завдання). The main defect is glossary leakage: "Circuit", "Gate" and "Backend" are left in English and left undeclined inside inflected Ukrainian prose — "варіюється від Circuit до Circuit", "загальна кількість Circuit, помножена на…", "більше часу, ніж Gate `x`", "на більшості Backend-ів" — which no native technical writer would write (схема / гейт / бекенд decline normally). Two term choices are imperfect but recognizable: shots is glossed as "кількість вимірювань (shots)", colliding with "вимірювання" used two sentences earlier for the measurement *instruction*, and "qubit-wise commuting" comes out as the clumsy calque "квантово-побітово комутуючі" instead of "покубітно комутуючі". "Провалені завдання" for failed jobs is a calque (невдалі / завдання, що завершилися помилкою) and "трансляції елементів PUB" for PUB broadcasting is defensible but readable as "translation" at first glance. None of these mislead; all are editorial polish.

examples.source: the total length varies from circuit to circuit. A measurement, for example, can take 56 times longer than an `x` gate.
examples.suggested: загальна довжина варіюється від схеми до схеми. Наприклад, вимірювання може займати в 56 разів більше часу, ніж гейт `x`.
examples.translation: загальна довжина варіюється від Circuit до Circuit. Наприклад, вимірювання може займати в 56 разів більше часу, ніж Gate `x`.
examples.why: English nouns are dropped into inflected Ukrainian prose without declension (від Circuit до Circuit, кількість Circuit, ніж Gate `x`, на більшості Backend-ів). Ukrainian requires case endings; the leak reads as untranslated glossary rather than a deliberate keep-English convention.

examples.source: the total number of circuits times the number of shots
examples.suggested: загальна кількість схем, помножена на кількість запусків (shots)
examples.translation: загальна кількість Circuit, помножена на кількість вимірювань (shots)
examples.why: Shots are circuit repetitions, not measurements; rendering them as "вимірювань" collides with "вимірювання" used four lines earlier for the measurement instruction itself. The parenthetical (shots) keeps the term identifiable, so this is imperfect rather than misleading.

examples.source: Estimator groups qubit-wise commuting observables, which reduces the number of executions.
examples.suggested: Estimator групує покубітно комутуючі спостережувані, що зменшує кількість виконань.
examples.translation: Estimator групує квантово-побітово комутуючі спостережувані, що зменшує кількість виконань.
examples.why: "Квантово-побітово" is a word-by-word unpacking of "qubit-wise" that no Ukrainian physicist would write; the established form is "покубітно". "Спостережувані" for observables is correct and consistent.

examples.source: failed or canceled jobs
examples.suggested: невдалі (завершені з помилкою) або скасовані завдання
examples.translation: провалені або скасовані завдання
examples.why: "Провалене завдання" is a calque of "failed job" with a human-failure connotation; Ukrainian technical writing uses "невдале" or "завершилося помилкою". It is used consistently, so the concept stays clear.

editor_note: No misleading content: the numbers (100+ 物理 Qubit, $2^{100}$, $10^{30}$ ビット, 30〜35 Qubit, 4方式のうち3つ, 2024年, 250社以上, 3兆回) and the at-worst caveats all survive intact, and the simulator argument teaches as clearly as the English. The main editorial defects are Latin-script term leaks in otherwise Japanese prose — "Qubit", "量子 Gate の動作", "Circuit が非常に複雑・深くなり" where 量子ビット / 量子ゲート / 量子回路 are the established domain terms (used consistently, so recognizable, but jarring to a native reader). Second, "leadership" is calqued as リーダーシップ where 経営層/上層部 is meant, producing the near-unparseable「あなたとあなたのリーダーシップが認識している限り」and「結果をリーダーシップと共有する」. Smaller items: the "at best … at worst" rhetorical pair loses its 「少なくとも/よくても」half while 最悪の場合 is kept; a particle slip「クライアントが量子セーフ暗号化への移行を支援しています」(should be クライアントの); "the fullest suite" flattened to 充実した while the neighboring superlatives keep 最も; and a few keigo slips (ご協力いただき, お役立てください, 参加していただけることを願っています) against the plain desu/masu convention.

examples.source: actions of quantum gates … The layers used to entangle many qubits make the circuits very complex / deep
examples.suggested: 量子ゲートの動作 … 多くの量子ビットをエンタングルさせる層によって回路が非常に複雑・深くなり
examples.translation: 量子 Gate の動作 … 多くの Qubit をエンタングルするために使用される層によって Circuit が非常に複雑・深くなり
examples.why: Japanese quantum documentation universally uses 量子ゲート / 量子回路 / 量子ビット; leaving 'Gate' and 'Circuit' in Latin script mid-sentence reads as an untranslated glossary leak rather than a deliberate keep-English convention (the surrounding text does translate 重ね合わせ, 基底状態, エンタングル).

examples.source: As long as you and your leadership are aware of these caveats … But sharing results with leadership that come from noiseless simulators
examples.suggested: これらの注意点をあなたと経営層が認識している限り … ノイズのないシミュレーターから得た結果を経営層と共有することは
examples.translation: これらの注意点をあなたとあなたのリーダーシップが認識している限り … ノイズのないシミュレーターからの結果をリーダーシップと共有することは
examples.why: リーダーシップ in Japanese means the quality of leading, not 'the leaders'. 「あなたのリーダーシップが認識している限り」is a calque a native technical writer would never produce; the same slip recurs at line 235 (「IBM Quantum Network 全体のリーダーシップが集まる」).

examples.source: sharing results … at best runs the risk of creating unrealistic expectations on precision. At worst, it can lead a team down a path that will not be fruitful for several years
examples.suggested: …よくても精度に関する非現実的な期待を生む危険があります。最悪の場合、…
examples.translation: …精度に関する非現実的な期待を生む危険があります。最悪の場合、チームを数年間実りのない道へと導く可能性があります。
examples.why: 'at best' is dropped while 最悪の場合 is kept, so the deliberate best-case/worst-case escalation that carries the pedagogical warning collapses into a single unranked risk statement.

examples.source: we are leveraging that expertise to help clients make the transition to quantum-safe cryptography
examples.suggested: その専門知識を活かして、クライアントの量子セーフ暗号への移行を支援しています
examples.translation: その専門知識を活かしてクライアントが量子セーフ暗号化への移行を支援しています
examples.why: The particle が makes clients the agent of 支援 ('clients support the transition'); it should be クライアントの. Reads as an unproofed MT artifact.

examples.source: We hope that you will participate … Please take a moment to help us improve our website
examples.suggested: 参加してもらえることを願っています … ご協力ください。いただいたフィードバックは…
examples.translation: 参加していただけることを願っています … ご協力いただき、ウェブサイトの改善にお役立てください
examples.why: いただく / お役立てください are keigo, against the file's otherwise consistent plain desu/masu register; a few slips only, so minor.

editor_note: One factual drift makes this FAIL: in the "Quantum circuits" answer block the English "a software development kit (SDK) like Qiskit" is rendered "bahasa pengaturcaraan seperti Qiskit" — it tells the learner Qiskit is a programming language, which is false (it is a Python SDK), and the whole SDK definition is dropped; the same sentence also renames "IBM Quantum Composer" to "IBM Composer". Secondary drift: "The words 'classical' and 'quantum' came to modify the word 'computing'" becomes "mula mengubah kata 'pengkomputeran'" (= began to *change* the word), which turns a grammatical-modification aside into a nonsensical claim. Terminology is otherwise consistent but odd: "circuit" is left untranslated and mid-sentence-capitalised throughout ("Circuit kuantum", "Circuit klasikal") where Malay has the standard "litar kuantum", and "gate" is likewise kept English. Pervasive calques remain — "mengambil keuntungan daripada undang-undang mekanik kuantum" (legal "undang-undang" for physical laws; "memanfaatkan hukum" is the Malay), "pemahaman perbualan" for "conversational understanding", "boleh mengubah permainan" for "game-changing", "membalikkan syiling" for coin tossing (should be "melambung"), "maklumat boleh dikurangkan kepada bit", "Pengambilan utama" for "Key takeaways", and one exclusive-"kami" slip where "kita" is meant. Register is the casual "kamu" throughout (MINOR).

examples.source: We can use a visual tool like [IBM Quantum Composer](...) or a software development kit (SDK) like [Qiskit](...) to construct quantum circuits.
examples.suggested: Kita boleh menggunakan alat visual seperti [IBM Quantum Composer](...) atau kit pembangunan perisian (SDK) seperti [Qiskit](...) untuk membina litar kuantum.
examples.translation: Kita boleh menggunakan alat visual seperti IBM [Composer](...) atau bahasa pengaturcaraan seperti [Qiskit](...) untuk membina Circuit kuantum.
examples.why: States Qiskit is a programming language — factually false and the SDK definition the English teaches is dropped; the product name is also truncated to "IBM Composer".

examples.source: The words "classical" and "quantum" came to modify the word "computing" because this is how scientists already modified the word "physics"
examples.suggested: Perkataan "klasikal" dan "kuantum" mula menjadi penerang kepada perkataan "pengkomputeran", kerana begitulah saintis telah menerangkan perkataan "fizik"
examples.translation: Kata-kata "klasikal" dan "kuantum" mula mengubah kata "pengkomputeran" kerana inilah cara saintis sudah mengubah kata "fizik"
examples.why: "modify" here is grammatical modification; "mengubah" means alter/change, so the Malay claims the adjectives changed the noun itself.

examples.source: quantum circuits / classical and quantum circuits
examples.suggested: litar kuantum / litar klasikal dan kuantum
examples.translation: Circuit kuantum / Circuit klasikal dan kuantum
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English and capitalised mid-sentence everywhere, although "litar" is the standard, unambiguous Malay technical term (cf. litar elektrik); the capitalised English word reads as an unprocessed glossary token.

examples.source: Quantum computers take advantage of the laws of quantum mechanics found in nature.
examples.suggested: Komputer kuantum memanfaatkan hukum mekanik kuantum yang terdapat di alam semula jadi.
examples.translation: Komputer kuantum mengambil keuntungan daripada undang-undang mekanik kuantum yang terdapat di alam semula jadi.
examples.why: "undang-undang" is statutory law; physical laws are "hukum". "mengambil keuntungan daripada" is a literal calque of "take advantage of" and carries an exploitative tinge.

examples.source: To get a better conversational understanding of the core concepts of quantum computing, watch this video…
examples.suggested: Untuk memahami konsep teras pengkomputeran kuantum dengan lebih baik sehingga boleh membincangkannya, tonton video ini…
examples.translation: Untuk mendapatkan pemahaman perbualan yang lebih baik tentang konsep teras pengkomputeran kuantum, tonton video ini…
examples.why: "pemahaman perbualan" is a word-for-word calque that means nothing in Malay; a native technical writer would rephrase the intent (understanding good enough to talk about it).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, correct quantities (41 kubitów for 20 triangles, $2n+1$ węzłów, second-order Trotter formula), and the informal "ty" register holds ("upewnij się", "zapisałeś swoje konto", "Poświęć chwilę"). The problems are terminological and cosmetic. "Circuit" is rendered three different ways in one file: "układy (Circuit)" (l.22), bare un-inflected English "Circuit" glued into Polish syntax ("budujemy Circuit (układy)", "generujemy Circuit o rosnącej głębokości", "Trotteryzowany Circuit kwantowy", "Trotteryzowanych Circuit" — ll.192/209/333), and finally "obwód/obwody" from Step 3 onward (ll.353, 394, 396); the bare "Circuit" does not decline and reads as an unresolved glossary token. Compounding this, glossary leakage produces mid-word capitals no Polish writer would type — "jednoQubitowe", "dwuQubitowymi", "Qubitu", "Qubitów", "Backendami" — plus inline English glosses "(Gate)" and "(Circuit)" in running prose. Smaller splits: "obroty" (l.22) vs "rotacji" (l.206) for rotations, "obserwowalnych spinowych" (l.41) vs "obserwable" (l.396), "bezszumowym" (l.22) vs "bezszumnemu" (l.415); and one grammar slip, "z splątującymi" should be "ze splątującymi" (l.22). None of this would mislead a learner, but a native technical editor would rewrite all of it.

examples.source: we construct circuits that approximate the time evolution operator
examples.suggested: budujemy obwody, które aproksymują operator ewolucji czasowej
examples.translation: budujemy Circuit (układy), które aproksymują operator ewolucji czasowej
examples.why: "Circuit" is split three ways across the file — "układy (Circuit)" (l.22), bare English "Circuit" used as an un-inflected Polish noun (ll.192, 209, 333), and "obwód/obwody" (ll.353, 394, 396). The bare form cannot decline ("Trotteryzowanych Circuit") and reads as a leaked glossary token; "obwód", already used later in the same file, is the conventional Polish term and should be used throughout.

examples.source: constructing circuits that alternate between single-qubit rotations and entangling two-qubit interactions
examples.suggested: budując obwody naprzemiennie łączące jednokubitowe rotacje ze splątującymi dwukubitowymi oddziaływaniami
examples.translation: budując układy (Circuit) naprzemiennie łączące jednoQubitowe obroty z splątującymi dwuQubitowymi oddziaływaniami
examples.why: Three separate non-native marks in one clause: mid-word capital Q ("jednoQubitowe", "dwuQubitowymi") is a glossary artifact, "z splątującymi" must be "ze splątującymi" before the sp- cluster, and "obroty" contradicts "rotacji" used for the same concept at l.206.

examples.source: yielding more reliable estimates of spin observables like ⟨Z_i⟩ and correlators ⟨Z_i Z_j⟩
examples.suggested: dając bardziej wiarygodne oszacowania obserwabli spinowych, takich jak $\langle Z_i \rangle$ i korelatorów $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$
examples.translation: dając bardziej wiarygodne szacunki obserwowalnych spinowych, takich jak $\langle Z_i \rangle$ i korelatory $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$
examples.why: "observables" is rendered as the adjectival "obserwowalnych" here but as the correct noun "obserwable" at l.396 ("obserwable Pauliego-Z"); the noun form is the domain standard and should be consistent. "korelatory" also fails to agree in case with "takich jak" governing the genitive.

examples.source: This allows us to apply two-qubit gates in parallel.
examples.suggested: Pozwala to na równoległe stosowanie bramek dwukubitowych.
examples.translation: Pozwala to na równoległe stosowanie dwuQubitowych bramek (Gate).
examples.why: The parenthetical "(Gate)" gloss (also "(Gate)" at l.207 and "(Circuit)" at l.22) is glossary machinery left in the running prose; "bramka" is already the unambiguous Polish term and needs no English crutch.

examples.source: a quantum spin model that captures essential features of quantum phase transitions
examples.suggested: kwantowy model spinowy, który oddaje istotne cechy kwantowych przejść fazowych
examples.translation: kwantowy model spinowy, który uchwytuje istotne cechy kwantowych przejść fazowych
examples.why: "uchwytuje" is a literal calque of "captures"; in Polish scientific prose a model "oddaje" or "ujmuje" the features of a phenomenon. Meaning survives, but the verb choice marks the sentence as translated.

editor_note: The body prose is faithful, natural pt-BR and terminologically solid: "transpilação", "gerenciador de passes em estágios", "síntese unitária"/"síntese de alto nível", "plugin de estágio do Transpiler" are correct and used consistently, and the informal "você" register holds throughout. Three things a native technical editor would still fix, none of them misleading. (1) In the "Próximos passos" admonition the first bullet appears TWICE — the translated "- [Criar um plugin do Transpiler](./create-transpiler-plugin)." is immediately followed by the raw untranslated English original "- [Create a transpiler plugin](/guides/create-transpiler-plugin).", so the reader sees a duplicated English link with a different href. (2) In the same block, "execução de circuits quânticos" leaves the English noun "circuits" untranslated; it must be "circuitos quânticos". (3) "Os nomes dos argumentos por palavra-chave" is a calque of "keyword arguments" — pt-BR technical usage is "argumentos nomeados" (or "argumentos de palavra-chave").

examples.source: - [Create a transpiler plugin](/guides/create-transpiler-plugin).
examples.suggested: - [Criar um plugin do Transpiler](./create-transpiler-plugin).
examples.translation:
- [Criar um plugin do Transpiler](./create-transpiler-plugin).
- [Create a transpiler plugin](/guides/create-transpiler-plugin).
examples.why: The English source bullet was left in place alongside its translation, producing a duplicated item in the 'Próximos passos' list — one in Portuguese and one in raw English, with two different hrefs for the same page.

examples.source: Check out the [tutorials](...) for examples of transpiling and running quantum circuits.
examples.suggested: Confira os [tutoriais](...) para exemplos de transpilação e execução de circuitos quânticos.
examples.translation: Confira os [tutoriais](...) para exemplos de transpilação e execução de circuits quânticos.
examples.why: 'circuits' is left in English inside an otherwise Portuguese noun phrase; the correct and elsewhere-used form in this corpus is 'circuitos quânticos'.

examples.source: The names of the keyword arguments correspond to the `name` attribute of the Operation class...
examples.suggested: Os nomes dos argumentos nomeados correspondem ao atributo `name` da classe Operation...
examples.translation: Os nomes dos argumentos por palavra-chave correspondem ao atributo `name` da classe Operation...
examples.why: 'argumentos por palavra-chave' is a literal calque of 'keyword arguments'; Brazilian Python/Qiskit writing uses 'argumentos nomeados' (or 'argumentos de palavra-chave'), and the 'por' construction reads as machine translation.

editor_note: The translation is faithful in substance — every truth table, ordering convention, little-endian explanation, CNOT/Toffoli description and Qiskit-patterns step matches the English, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout with no dumneavoastră slips — but it needs a copy-edit pass. The worst spot is the Measurements paragraph: "dat fiind un stat cuantic cu $N$ biți ... o măsurătoare va colpsa starea" uses "stat" (a political state) instead of "stare" and the non-word "colpsa" for "colapsa"; the preceding sentence has "superpozița" for "superpoziția". Core terms are split within the file: "circuit" leaks untranslated and capitalized as English in ~8 places ("primul Circuit diagram", "Maparea problemei noastre pe Circuite", "Optimizarea Circuit-ului", "crearea unui Circuit cu o poartă $X$"); "gate" is "Gate-uri" in the headings but "poartă/porți" in every body sentence; "entanglement" is "entanglement/entanglat" in the body but "întrețesați/Întrețesarea" in the Critical-concepts bullets and True/False question 2; "superposition" is "suprapunere" at its first definition (line 182) and "superpoziție" everywhere after; and "half-adder" appears as "semi-sumator", "half-adder", "adunătorul cuantic pe jumătate" and "jumătatea de adunător". One summary bullet also loosens the concept: "în superpoziție față de șirurile de biți clasic permise" says "relative to" rather than "a superposition *of/over*" those bitstrings.

examples.source: In particular, given an $N$-bit quantum state ... a measurement will collapse the state to one of the basis functions
examples.suggested: În particular, dată fiind o stare cuantică cu $N$ biți ... o măsurătoare va colapsa starea la una dintre funcțiile de bază
examples.translation: În particular, dat fiind un stat cuantic cu $N$ biți ... o măsurătoare va colpsa starea la una dintre funcțiile de bază
examples.why: "stat" is a false friend (a nation-state); the physics term is "stare". "colpsa" is a non-word typo for "colapsa". Both sit in the single most important sentence of the Measurements section.

examples.source: This is the first circuit diagram we see with two qubits / Mapping our problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.suggested: Aceasta este prima diagramă de circuit pe care o vedem cu doi qubiți / Maparea problemei noastre pe circuite și operatori cuantici / Optimizarea circuitului pentru hardware-ul țintă
examples.translation: Acesta este primul Circuit diagram pe care îl vedem cu doi qubiți / Maparea problemei noastre pe Circuite și operatori cuantici / Optimizarea Circuit-ului pentru hardware-ul țintă
examples.why: A no-translate/glossary leak: "circuit" is left capitalized as English (and "Circuit diagram" left entirely untranslated) in ~8 places, while the same section elsewhere correctly writes "diagrama circuitului" and "circuitul". Reads as raw pipeline residue in otherwise clean Romanian.

examples.source: another key feature of qubits is that they can be entangled with one another / Multiple qubits can be entangled so that... / Entanglement means the state of one qubit is independent...
examples.suggested: Pick one convention and keep it — e.g. "entanglare/entanglat" everywhere, including the Critical-concepts bullet and True/False question 2.
examples.translation: pot fi *entanglați* unul cu celălalt / Entanglementul poate lua și alte forme / Mai mulți qubiți pot fi **întrețesați** / Întrețesarea înseamnă că starea unui qubit este independentă
examples.why: The body teaches the concept exclusively as "entanglement/entanglat"; the summary bullets and the True/False quiz switch to "întrețesați/Întrețesarea", so the learner is quizzed on a word the lesson never introduced. Same split affects "superposition": "*suprapunere*" at its first italicized definition (line 182) vs "superpoziție" everywhere afterwards.

examples.source: Multiple qubits can be in a superposition over the classically allowed bitstrings called computational basis states.
examples.suggested: Mai mulți qubiți pot fi într-o superpoziție a șirurilor de biți clasic permise, numite **stări ale bazei computaționale**.
examples.translation: Mai mulți qubiți pot fi în superpoziție față de șirurile de biți clasic permise, numite **stări de bază computațională**.
examples.why: "față de" means "relative to / compared with", so the bullet no longer says the superposition is composed of those basis states — it flattens the key idea in the summary list. Also splits "stări de bază computațională" against "stările bazei computaționale" used in the body (line 212).

examples.source: the quantum half adder / the quantum half-adder circuit / the quantum half-adder over the classical half-adder
examples.suggested: semi-sumatorul cuantic / circuitul semi-sumator cuantic — reusing the term already introduced at line 144
examples.translation: adunătorul cuantic pe jumătate / circuitul cuantic al adunătorului pe jumătate / *jumătății de adunător cuantic* / circuitul clasic al jumătății de adunător
examples.why: "adunător pe jumătate" is a word-for-word calque that reads as "an adder done halfway"; the file already introduced the correct "circuitul semi-sumator" in the classical section, then abandons it for three other renderings, breaking the classical→quantum parallel the module is built on.

examples.source: the transpiler also implements something called "error suppression and mitigation" to try to minimize the effect of errors on the result
examples.suggested: ...pentru a încerca să minimizeze efectul erorilor asupra rezultatului
examples.translation: transpilerul implementează și ceea ce se numește „suprimarea și mitigarea erorilor", pentru a minimiza efectul erorilor asupra rezultatului
examples.why: The English hedge "to try to" is dropped, turning a best-effort technique into a guaranteed one — a small strengthening of the claim in exactly the place where a beginner forms expectations about hardware noise.

examples.source: before, during, or after a computation / classical two-bit gates / Olivia Lane's course
examples.suggested: după un calcul / porțile clasice cu doi biți / cursul Oliviei Lane
examples.translation: înainte, în timpul sau după o calcul / porțile clasice cu două biți / cursul lui Olivia Lane
examples.why: Three plain agreement errors a native technical editor would fix on sight: wrong gender on "un calcul" and "doi biți", and a masculine possessive "lui" applied to a feminine given name.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — the physics, the QKE workflow, all quantities (128 rânduri / 14 caracteristici / al 15-lea element, 90 antrenament / 30 testare, 0.90^10 ≈ 35%, adâncime 60 vs 77, (1-p)^N) and every caveat survive intact. But a Romanian technical editor would rework several things. Core terms are split within the file: "feature map" appears as "mapare a caracteristicilor" in the introduction (§Introducere, Pasul 1) and as "hartă de caracteristici" from the `z_feature_map` discussion onward; "pass manager" is rendered "managerul de pași preset" in Pasul 2 (which reads as "manager of steps" — the wrong sense of "pass") but is kept in English later ("un pass manager prestabilit", "pass manager-ul"). There are also outright native-speaker errors: "Te recomandăm să explorezi" (must be "Îți recomandăm"), "diferite pasuri de transpilare" ("pasuri" is not the plural of "pas"), "adâncimile transpilate pe două qubiți" (masculine → "pe doi qubiți"), "Aceasta este adevărat în general" (agreement), and "informațiile pot trebui mutate de la qubit la qubit". Add glossary-substitution artifacts with stray capitals mid-sentence ("un Circuit cuantic", "toți N Qubiți", "adâncimea Gate-urilor" beside the correct "porți native" elsewhere), the calque "produs intern" for inner product (standard Romanian is "produs scalar"), "devin rapid intractabile", "calculele la scară utilă" for utility-scale, one formal-address slip ("Rețineți că am utilizat simetria...") in an otherwise consistent "tu" register, and a dropped hedge in "Kernelurile clasice ar fi putut rezolva ... la fel de bine" (EN: "would likely have been able").

examples.source: we will use the preset pass manager which provides the highest level of optimization / a preset pass manager will often return the same circuit
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout — e.g. "pass manager-ul prestabilit" in both places; "manager de pași" reads as "manager of steps" and loses the transpiler-pass sense.
examples.translation: vom folosi managerul de pași preset care oferă cel mai înalt nivel de optimizare / un pass manager prestabilit va returna adesea același circuit
examples.why: The same Qiskit object is named two different ways in the same file, and the first naming picks the wrong sense of "pass".

examples.source: feature map / feature mapping
examples.suggested: Pick one — "hartă de caracteristici" is the more idiomatic and is already dominant — and use it from the introduction on.
examples.translation: „mapare a caracteristicilor" / „mapare de caracteristici pre-creată" in the introduction, then „hartă de caracteristici" (l.281 onward) and „hartă de entanglement" (l.653)
examples.why: A core concept of the whole lesson is split between two renderings, so the intro and the body look like they discuss different objects.

examples.source: We recommend you explore what can be done with current quantum computers
examples.suggested: Îți recomandăm să explorezi ce se poate face cu calculatoarele cuantice actuale
examples.translation: Te recomandăm să explorezi ce se poate face cu calculatoarele cuantice actuale
examples.why: "a recomanda" takes the dative — "te recomandăm" means "we recommend you (as a person)"; a native writer would never produce this.

examples.source: there is some variation in the total gate depth with different transpilation passes … variation in the two-qubit transpiled depths
examples.suggested: …cu diferite treceri (pass-uri) de transpilare … variație în adâncimile transpilate pe doi qubiți
examples.translation: există o oarecare variație în adâncimea totală a porților cu diferite pasuri de transpilare … variație în adâncimile transpilate pe două qubiți
examples.why: "pasuri" is not a valid plural of "pas", and "două qubiți" mis-genders qubit (masculine, "doi qubiți").

examples.source: Note that we have leveraged the symmetry of a kernel matrix…
examples.suggested: Reține că am utilizat simetria unei matrice kernel…
examples.translation: Rețineți că am utilizat simetria unei matrice de kernel… În funcție de implementarea ta și de precizia necesară…
examples.why: Formal 2nd-person plural "Rețineți" collides with the informal "tu" used everywhere else — including two clauses later in the same paragraph ("implementarea ta").

examples.source: Classical kernels would likely have been able to solve this classification problem with 100% accuracy as well.
examples.suggested: Foarte probabil, kernelurile clasice ar fi putut rezolva această problemă de clasificare cu 100% acuratețe.
examples.translation: Kernelurile clasice ar fi putut rezolva această problemă de clasificare cu 100% acuratețe la fel de bine.
examples.why: The hedge "likely" is dropped, turning a cautious statement about classical baselines into a flat assertion.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner — the technically load-bearing passages (merge_bounds picking the switch point that minimizes total bias, "เลือกค่าที่น้อยกว่าระหว่าง forward bound ... และ backward-propagation bound", the qubit-6 X-eigenstate commutation bullets, "trivial bounds ค่าสอง") are all faithful, and the informal register holds with no ครับ/ค่ะ. But an editor would change several things. (1) Heading language is inconsistent: "ขั้นตอนที่ 0/1/2" are translated while "## Step 3. Execute" and "## Step 4. Post-process" are left in raw English. (2) "error mitigation" is rendered four ways within the file — "การลดข้อผิดพลาด" (Background), "การลด error" (workflow section), bare "mitigation", and then "การลดความคลาดเคลื่อน" in Step 3 — and "shot" alternates between English "shot" and transliterated "ช็อต"; loanword casing also drifts (qubit/Qubit, gate/Gate). (3) A few qualifiers are lost or blunted: the Step-2 note drops "in time" from "run as close in time as possible to the learned noise model" (Thai reads only "รันให้ใกล้เคียงกับ noise model ... มากที่สุด", which obscures the noise-drift rationale), "graded shade" becomes the temporal "แบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป" instead of ไล่ระดับ, "controllably tune the bias" becomes "ควบคุม ... ได้อย่างมีสัดส่วน" (proportionally), and "decrease significantly faster" loses "significantly".

examples.source: ## Step 3. Execute … ## Step 4. Post-process
